title: Persuasive Geographies: All the Right Places, All the Right Traces
coreMove: Move the message into a setting whose traces make the desired meaning easier to receive.
sourcePressure: The source says messages are shaped by physical and psychological places, and that placement context can reduce resistance before merits are weighed.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Decorate the environment until people feel good.

hook: An abstract claim that attention changes everything
A generic meeting where someone makes a better pitch
A clever sentence about persuasion before any concrete object appears
counterintuition: You think persuasion happens during the ask, but it happens before it
The obvious factor is not always the important one
Influence is not manipulation when used well
tryThisNow: Set a timer and reflect on attention
Write down three ways to be more persuasive
Ask yourself what matters most right now

exampleSpecs.audience: a nonprofit placing refund-savings prompts where stress is lowest
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether location changes a refund choice before the form is reviewed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the coordinator moves the savings split card from the exit desk to the calm document-check table
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a numbered waiting-room ticket beside a savings split card

exampleSpecs.audience: a pharmacist placing medication questions at bedside rather than checkout
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the setting lowers resistance to asking for help
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the pharmacist asks adherence questions while the patient is still seated with discharge papers, not while a line forms behind them
exampleSpecs.firstImage: discharge papers on a rolling bedside table

exampleSpecs.audience: an attorney reducing client shutdown before plea discussion
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a quieter place changes how legal options are heard
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the attorney moves the first explanation from the crowded hallway to a small file room with chairs at the same level
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a file room chair pulled beside a metal cabinet

exampleSpecs.audience: a lender placing repair-cost comparisons near the service bay
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the offer is heard as uptime protection rather than debt
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the lender sets the financing sheet beside a worn bearing pulled from a combine, not beside balloons at the booth
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a worn bearing on a service-bay counter

exampleSpecs.audience: a development officer asking donors for HVAC funds
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the ask belongs near fragile artifacts rather than a banquet table
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the officer lets donors feel the cool storage-room air before showing the pledge card
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a storage-room door opening onto wrapped frames

exampleSpecs.audience: a platform designer placing support options near the confusion point
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether psychological place matters more than page location
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the designer maps refund clicks to the first confusing quiz screen and moves help there
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a quiz results page with one skipped item circled

skillTargets: choose the place or mental state where resistance is lower for a good reason
move messages away from settings that distort them
read traces already attached to a setting

tryThisNowSpec: Move one planned message to the place or mental state where the person can judge it most fairly, then note what traces that setting adds.
